body: Evidence for draft b72b51cf, from the Mac window hall9k-a7 at 2026-09-24 19:08 EDT. Hypothesis CONFIRMED: the Mac minted the second task of all three pairs. (1) The Mac has arx-platform registered (home ~/.hall9k/projects/arx-platform, remote AgelessRx/arx-platform, connection github Hallmanac via gh-cli, the same login as Windows) with auto pr-review on (normal, default); its per-project ceiling here is 0, so the minted task queues and never runs. (2) h9kd.log lines (Mac local time, EDT): '2026-09-24 18:50:24 info: AutoPrReviewEngine Auto-pr-review observed a review request: AgelessRx/arx-platform#2147 in project arx-platform, auto pr-review is on here (normal, default), task 84e20e28 is created and reviewing'; then 18:50:26 DispatchEngine 'Task 01a0d59c-...-cc2d84e20e28 stays queued: project arx-platform is paused, its per-project ceiling is 0'; then '18:56:23 ... #2147 ... task 5859bfc5 already covers it; nothing new was created'. For #2143: '2026-09-24 11:36:41 ... #2143 ... task a3ab84ac is created and reviewing' (NOT 15:36; the 15:36:34 line is a failed sweep, gh pr list --search mentions:Hallmanac exited 1, unexpected EOF on the GraphQL post), then '11:45:39 ... #2143 ... task 9233aaaa already covers it'. For #2140: '2026-09-23 14:42:40 ... #2140 ... task 0ac2114a is created and reviewing', then '14:54:39 ... #2140 ... task 0222aa22 already covers it'. Each pair is one mint per node inside the same sweep window, and each node's later sweep sees the other's task and says already covers it; the per-node dedup cannot see the other node's mint until it has replicated. The card becomes a fleet-level dedup. Placement of b72b51cf is Brian's call.
